extracted.intended_audience: Individuals and organizations receiving NEH awards (NEH grantees) and their grant administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for NEH grantees on complying with administrative, financial, and audit-related obligations and other non-programmatic requirements while managing an NEH award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Grant Management oversees compliance with the administrative requirements of your award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have questions about administrative requirements, contact grantmanagement@neh.gov. Applies to both individuals and organizations holding NEH awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost principles
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Grant Management is responsible for overseeing compliance with applicable cost principles governing award expenditures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For guidance or questions about allowable costs and cost accounting principles under your NEH award, contact grantmanagement@neh.gov. This applies to both individual and organizational grantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Grant Management oversees compliance with audit requirements related to NEH awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions about audit obligations (e.g., single-audit or other audit-related reporting) should be directed to grantmanagement@neh.gov. Relevant for both individuals and organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other non-programmatic aspects of your award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Grant Management handles other non-programmatic aspects of awards beyond programmatic performance, such as administrative and financial compliance matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For any non-programmatic issues concerning your award, contact grantmanagement@neh.gov. The page indicates separate resources or contacts may exist for individuals versus organizations.
